laws.narrowing: The ALU-roofline receipt's own verdict is MIXED, not ALU_BOUND. Quoting ARM A's 1.51x jump as a generic MLP-is-ALU-bound law silently widens ORGAN, MODEL, and MACHINE. Narrowed to the measured organ/parent/machine. Citation, not a new measurement.

laws.statement: On qwen3.8-27b sealed-3.14, this machine, one representative MLP layer of affine2 geo_tpr64: ARM A (same bytes, arithmetic stripped) is cited at 497.4 effective GB/s against production 329.6 (receipt receipts/future/MLP_ALU_ROOFLINE.json#mlp.arm_a_stripped.effective_gb_s). laws.statement_before_narrowing: MLP is ALU-bound: stripping decode arithmetic is a machine-general way to reach the roof.

laws.statement: 497.4 GB/s is the ARM-A-stripped MLP affine2 rate on qwen3.8-27b sealed-3.14, one representative layer, this machine (receipts/future/MLP_ALU_ROOFLINE.json#mlp.arm_a_stripped.effective_gb_s). Causal-budget rungs that put 'every organ at 497.4' are hypothetical ladders, not replications.

negative_findings: ModelLake seals on disk are often MANIFEST_ONLY; scientific seal is the independent whole-tree verification
three (or more) downloads can sit in partial/ while five curriculum roles are sealed — the available-set is the sealed set, not the lake listing
LM head landing on 497.4 is a same-parent coincidence, not an organ replication of the MLP ARM A law
purpose: Time-index the scientific universe of Odyssey I so a law cannot silently inherit specimens that were not sealed when it was made. Scope begins MODEL_LOCAL / ORGAN_LOCAL / MACHINE_LOCAL. Widening without a named replicating specimen is impossible.

universal_conclusion.message: LAW-MLP-ARITHMETIC-SENSITIVITY: refusing 'All Hawking models behave this way' while scope.model is MODEL_LOCAL. Say 'within currently sealed specimens qwen3.8-27b-abliterated-bf16@local', never 'all Hawking models'.

widen_without_specimen.message: LAW-MLP-ARITHMETIC-SENSITIVITY: widening model without a named replicating specimen (got None). Widening without a replicating specimen is impossible, not discouraged.
